environment.description: Same gRPC service deployed on EKS with Step Functions integration. The pod's IRSA role has a DynamoDB policy with leading-key condition enforcement using dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition key bound to ${aws:PrincipalTag/TenantID}. The IAM role has a session tag 'TenantID' propagated from the OIDC provider's sub claim mapped through EKS pod identity webhook. Additionally, the DynamoDB table has a resource policy with an explicit Deny for any GetItem/Query where dynamodb:LeadingKeys does not match the caller's aws:PrincipalTag/TenantID. The Step Functions state machine uses a task role with identical leading-key restrictions scoped to the originating execution's tenant context passed via taskToken. Note: the condition uses StringLike with pattern '${aws:PrincipalTag/TenantID}#*' on dynamodb:LeadingKeys.

config.irsa_config: EKS OIDC provider maps serviceaccount annotation eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn to role with session tag TenantID derived from pod identity webhook injecting tenant from namespace label
config.step_functions_task_role: Scoped identically with LeadingKeys condition from execution input tenant_id
